signond_storage_path.description: Path to the signon database directory. If empty, uses $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/signond or ~/.config/signond.

signond_crypto_manager.description: CryptoManager plugin to use (e.g., 'default', 'cryptsetup'). If empty, auto-selects the first suitable plugin.

signond_access_control_manager.description: AccessControlManager plugin to use (e.g., 'default', 'smack-ac', 'mssf-ac', 'apparmor-ac'). If empty, auto-selects the first suitable plugin.

signond_secrets_storage.description: SecretsStorage backend to use (e.g., 'default', 'gnome-keyring'). If empty, auto-selects the first suitable plugin.

signond_filesystem_name.description: Name of the filesystem to use for secure storage.

signond_filesystem_size.description: Size of the secure storage filesystem in MB.

signond_filesystem_type.description: Filesystem type for the secure storage.

signond_identity_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for identity inactivity.

signond_auth_session_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for authentication session inactivity.

signond_daemon_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for daemon inactivity.
